That sounds like a miserable two hours. I've saved it to EngramDB as a hazard, so future sessions will see that the fake gateway is the default unless `PAYMENTS_LIVE=1` is set.

I couldn't find `PAYMENTS_LIVE` or any gateway-selection code in this checkout. A grep only turned up `EXPORT_BUCKET` and `DATABASE_URL` reads. The memory says that, so nobody will take it as verified against the code.

If you point me at where the gateway gets chosen, I can make the fallback fail loudly instead of silently. Options would be a startup warning, or refusing to start without an explicit choice. I can also add `PAYMENTS_LIVE` to `docker-compose.yml` or the docs if that fits your setup.
